name: Survey Analysis
description: Analyze survey responses through MCP tools: code free-text answers into a codebook-backed column, build frequency tables and cross-tabulations, and chart the results as a native sheet chart.

prompts.name: code-open-text
prompts.title: Code the open-text answers
prompts.text: On the "Responses" sheet, use survey_code_responses on the "How did you hear about us?" column to canonicalize the messy answers into a code column, and show me the codebook with counts.

prompts.name: satisfaction-by-plan
prompts.title: Satisfaction by plan, tabulated and charted
prompts.text: On the "Responses" sheet, cross-tabulate "Plan" by "Satisfaction" with survey_crosstab, build the satisfaction frequency table with survey_frequencies, and chart it with survey_chart_results.
